title: Work window regression tests: guard stable table layout and inherited end position
outcome: Add lasting executable coverage for the table layout half of the window-convergence repair and end-position liveness, beyond the existing hook geometry witness.
acceptance: A maintained test discriminates removal of the stable table column layout across different mounted row subsets, rather than only testing hook convergence under synthetic auto-layout geometry.
The inherited scrolled-tree to table witness requires useful end-range rows and scroll/anchor position in addition to bounded commits and mounted-row count.
